title: Black Screen During Gameplay Without Angelica
note: This is a SEPARATE bug from the splash screen crash. The Batch 1 analysis correctly identified a gameplay rendering issue, but it is NOT the cause of the splash screen crash.

findings.summary: During gameplay (after world load), the screen may be black when Angelica is not installed. This is a separate issue from the splash screen crash.
findings.root_cause: RenderHelper.drawLods() manipulates OpenGL state without preserving it. Specifically, glClearColor(1,1,1,0.0F) uses alpha=0 which can cause framebuffer issues, and GL_BLEND is disabled unconditionally.
evidence: RenderHelper.java:27,35: GL_ALPHA_TEST manipulation without state preservation

gap_analysis.current_behavior: OpenGL state modified without preservation, causing rendering issues
gap_analysis.required_behavior: OpenGL state should be saved and restored

proposed_fix.approach: Save and restore OpenGL state in RenderHelper
implementation_steps: 1. Save GL_BLEND, GL_ALPHA_TEST, GL_COLOR_CLEAR_VALUE state before changes

relation_to_primary_bug.note: This is a DIFFERENT bug from the splash screen crash. Both should be fixed, but they occur at different times (gameplay vs initialization) and have different root causes (RenderHelper vs MixinFramebuffer).

confidence_reason: Code clearly shows GL state manipulation without preservation
